headline: License requests, 2027 renewals, and New Year's Eve hour extensions for Waltham businesses.
summary: Deep Ellum and Shiki Shabu Shabu are asked to appear about police reports. Other items include changes of managers and officers and the 2027 meeting schedule.
items: Extended hours at Shopper's Café, 731 Moody Street, for the November 15, 2026 New England Patriots game, 9:00 a.m. (pre-approved 11/13/2026)
One-day beer and wine permit for the McKenna Family Christmas Party at the Paine Estate, 100 Robert Treat Paine Drive, on December 13, 2026, 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., 90 people
Change of officers and stock interest for UMA Convenience, Inc., d/b/a Moody Spa, 811 Moody Street; manager remains Sandip Patel
Change of manager for Moody & Charles, LLC, d/b/a Stazione Di Federal, 123 Moody Street, from David Alphonse to Richard Brackett
New common victualler license and new manager for Guatelinda, Inc., d/b/a Tortilleria Y Pupuseria, 581 Moody Street; manager is Natalio E. Garcia
Approve the 2027 licensing meeting dates, held on the fourth Wednesday of each month
Approve the 2027 renewals of common victualler and liquor licenses
Extend New Year's Eve hours until 2:00 a.m. on January 1, 2027, for 28 licensees
Request that Deep Ellum, 484 Moody Street, appear about the October 25, 2026 police report #26035846
Request that Shiki Shabu Shabu, 342 Moody Street, appear about the October 31, 2026 police report #26036595
